Caroline Kennedy's paternal grandfather.why: Rarely stated, and almost only in passing: summing every phrasing searched gives at most about 50 statements (several of them copies of one Wikipedia sentence about his funeral, or news about her following him as an ambassador), against about 1,000 for each premise (P1: 'Caroline Kennedy, daughter of' 1,062; P2: "JFK's father" 722) and about 70,000 mentions of Caroline Kennedy, i.e. about 5% of either premise and under 0.1% of the subject. Searched from both ends: Joseph P. Kennedy Sr.'s Wikipedia article never names Caroline, and hers states it once, in the body, not the lead. Hence 'likely' rather than 'very_likely': it is in text, but at a twentieth of its premises (the review's Boleyn case, at 12-25%, was rated medium). Verifier re-check from Joseph P. Kennedy Sr.'s end with the 'granddaughter of' and 'Joe Kennedy' variants adds at most a few dozen hits, and the samples read are about other grandchildren (Maria Shriver), so the ratio stays around 5% and 'likely' holds.
